subject: USE statement
notes: kb/Work PB363 LANDED. Every statement bound in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure is asked, in BindStatement, whether the emitter-verified store classification (BoundStores.StoresInto, the generated exhaustive visitor) stores into any report's control data item, a group containing one, or an item subordinate to one; COBOL2378, one diagnostic per store (a nested statement reports at its own position and suppresses its container's). A BY REFERENCE CALL argument / INVOKE write-back is not counted: whether the callee alters it is not decidable from the source element. Residual not claimed: a store through a REDEFINES alias of a record that holds the control item is not related to it (the hierarchy test only) - a narrower-than-rule reading that never rejects legal source.
